title: Alert
description: A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger. Flat, token-tinted, one icon.
usage: For information the user must not miss but does not need to act on right now. Toasts interrupt; alerts stay. One alert per region is usually enough.
a11y: Use role="alert" only for messages injected after load; static alerts are plain regions. Tone is never carried by color alone: the title says it, and the icon is decorative (aria-hidden="true") so screen readers do not announce an unnamed image. Title and body text measure at least 12.68:1 and 5.44:1 in every tone and theme; the tone icon at least 3.1:1 (success, dark). Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
